messages.content: ami ekta creator hisebe first time price barate jacchi, ki bhabe announce korbo?
Actually transparency shobcheye best approach - keno barcho sheta clearly bolo, value ki notun thakবে sheta o mention koro।
existing subscriber der ki grandfather kora uchit old price e?
Depend kore business decision er upor, kintu honestly onek creator e eta kore loyalty reward hisebe - short term e revenue kom hoy, kintu trust build hoy.
eta korle new subscriber der kache unfair lagbe na?
Actually na, eta standard practice bhabে dekha hoy - loyalty reward kono industry te unusual na, new subscriber der eta bujhte problem hobar kotha na।
